paragraphs.source_en: “Ah, my dear, I hardly knew you,” said Anna Mikháylovna with a happy smile, ambling lightly up to the count’s niece. “I have come, and am at your service to help you nurse *my uncle*. I imagine what you have gone through,” and she sympathetically turned up her eyes.
